notes.title: Solenars Edge Rebirth v1.3 update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687460/a7fbcafed73948c20774b7faf4a43016897a17cf.png[/img]

Hello guys, been a long time since I have been able to work on this game. The files have been out of reach for a bit and I am still trying to work on it. I could use your help in donations and in pointing out spelling issues. If you see an error, please shoot me an email at syukino56@gmaildotcom with a screen shot or info. Keep in mind this isn't an early access game and the game is complete from start to finish. So I will listen to all, but won't always be able to act. Without a moment to spare, let us get into the new update.

-Added in a brief Ternesta fight with a Soldier and Knight aiding the heroes.

-Added in a save point in Ternesta as Soren.

-Added in a Nature's Kiss *Antidote* in the Item Shop in the Town of Eternity.

-Added in a merchant at the Slyph Cave Entrance.

-Changed position of a treasure chest that was previously out of reach.

-Increased the amount of steps you need to take to run into a battle in Slyph Cave.

-Status effects are no longer left on after a battle.

-Changed Balthus' Cure spell to be learned at level 3 instead of 4.

-Gave Balthus the Remedy spell to cure some status effects.

-The choice to go to hell in chapter 5 no longer issues a game over if yes is chosen.

-Fixed some grammar.

-You can now choose to start from Balthus' Requiem or skip it completely 
and jump into Solenars Edge Rebirth. *Keep in mind you will lose a chunk of the story and a bit of rewards for skipping. You will also not be able to name Balthus' Companion.*

-The start with Emo Natsu has been completely removed, but you will see him throughout the game.

Donate here for better content overtime:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/872050/Solenars_Edge_Rebirth_Donation/

Donate here if you want to help immediately and get things done much quicker as well as help save Team Syukino in the long run.

https://www.paypal.me/SYukino

*All donations are optional and are not required.*

I want to say that although I appreciate any and all kinds of feedback. I am only human.

"Let us go where the world takes us~" -Syukino.

PS: I really hope this game isn't way too easy now. But, you know how to make it harder if it is. GL and have fun!

notes.title: Solenars Edge Rebirth Update 1.2.
notes.content:
Enter this code at the start of the game for extra items: 8912

Game is on sale for the cheapest it will be for a very long time. Please enjoy.
 
I went in and fixed some bugs here and there, not anything too major.

Big Beef Gai and the Sylph are unlockable in two secret dungeons.

Access to the character Kannono is now available in the End Game Resort.

Happy Holidays.

notes.title: Remnants of The Past Update
notes.content:
This is an invisible update calling to attention the many things that have gone unseen. It's more of a mini player guide to help those confused find there way in the world of Alcornagia a bit more.

1. At the start of the game you can enter a code. The code is: 8912 which will unlock a useful secret.
2. Save as often as possible and check out the info broker for hints.
3. Solenars Edge Rebirth is a remastered version of the original Solenars Edge and has gone through many changes. Solenars Edge After Story, Trials of Almachia, Solenars Edge: Arena. Solenars Edge: Legends. Solenars Edge: Champions did not make the final cut in the remaster. But the events are all summarized in the Solenars Edge: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn story found in your game's folder. Think of it as free dlc without having to download it seperately, it contains spoilers, so it's suggested to read after you play and beat rebirth. The short trailer is up now.
4. Nerine is the dedicated healer. *Chapter 2*
5. Phyrith is the dedicated tank. *Chapter 3*
6. Although there isn't a new game+ if you beat the game you have an extra mode filled with hours of bonus content.
7. There is tons of hidden treasure scattered around everywhere, and it's beneficial to pick some of it up along the way.

notes.title: Solenars Edge Rebirth v1.1 Update Patch
notes.content:
Solenars Edge Rebirth has been updated!

-Soren has two new skills (Comet Sword, Jump)
-Weapon damage of all characters have been boosted.
-Fixed bug in chapter 3 where if you failed the code on the door to the Sealed
Labyrinth of Nova Frost, it would have the window U.I. cover your entire screen.
-Revamped battle system for faster, more engaging battles.

*Restoration release date has been updated to August 18th!*

As always, go where the world takes us! -Syukino
